counterfactual_pairing: every sampled alternate-language row retains the same visual pair under its correct language
reverse_rule: add the exact reverse of every non-self pair and negate the T1 label
tie_rule: retain label 0 with soft target P(B>A)=0.5
long_gap_rule: deterministic 64-position maximum per trajectory over gaps 17--32
selection: stable evenly spaced indices inside each sorted finite stratum
